prior_summary: Concurrent-goal preserving lookahead, implemented as an amortized selection objective for a learned action diffusion policy. Three bootstrapped action-conditioned transition models score five local alternatives to training-time DDPM clean estimates using exact world-pose containment margins, learned short-horizon remaining-work forecasts, retention of observed red/drawer/blue goals, ensemble disagreement and a learned behavior-support penalty. Detached selections supervise the denoiser. Deployment uses the fixed DDPM sampler, not an unsupported external controller or runtime K-chunk reranker.
applicable_conditions: The entire expanded insert_blue slice, including incoming red lowering, red release and retreat, blue approach, closure, lift, transport, lowering and optional terminal continuation. Two causal world-state observations identify joint/finger motion, TCP-object relationships, which object appears coupled, drawer opening and concurrent object-goal status. Applicability is local to demonstrated robot/controller dynamics and supported transitions; measured boundary values are not hard rejection thresholds.
termination_guidance: Use measured simultaneous success: drawer position strictly greater than 0.26 m, red fully contained in the outside pad with center z strictly between 0.014 and 0.031 m, and blue fully contained in the moving drawer XY cavity with center z strictly between 0.053 and 0.074 m. Include rotated cube extents. No release, hold, speed or TCP-clearance requirement. If continuing after success, remain within demonstrated release/retreat support while preserving achieved goals. Predicted success is never sufficient.
limitations: The epsilon-only API cannot select among fully sampled diffusion chunks. Selection is therefore distilled during training and is not recomputed by a dynamics critic at deployment. The progress head predicts local future geometric work, not full remaining time. Successful demonstrations weakly identify counterfactual dynamics; bootstrap disagreement is not calibrated uncertainty. Candidate trust gates and a Gaussian support surrogate reduce but cannot certify against critic exploitation, lost grasp, collisions or recovery failure. No IK, force model, collision model, image encoder or joint-action equivariance is claimed.

config.coverage: All twelve assigned expanded slices with no additional phase filtering or per-skill normalization fit

diffusion.action_representation: Shared-normalized absolute seven joint targets and gripper command

transition_ensemble.outputs: qpos, qvel, TCP/red/blue poses, drawer position and velocity
transition_ensemble.known_slot_zero: Current observed state; action at t-1 is not a new control
transition_ensemble.quaternion_loss: Squared sine of half relative angle, sign-invariant geodesic surrogate

selection_teacher.ensemble_risk: Half mean plus half worst member
